defmodule MessageQueue.Consumer do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @moduledoc """
  Consumes messages from the internal queue and processes
  administrative actions with full audit logging.
  """

  defmodule AuditLog do
    defstruct [:timestamp, :actor_id, :action, :resource, :result, :metadata]

    def record(entry = %AuditLog{}) do
      Logger.info("AUDIT: #{inspect(entry)}")
      {:ok, persist_to_store(entry)}
    end

    defp persist_to_store(entry) do
      :ets.insert(:audit_log, {System.monotonic_time(), entry})
      entry
    end
  end

  defmodule Authorization do
    @role_hierarchy %{
      "super_admin" => 100,
      "admin" => 80,
      "manager" => 60,
      "operator" => 40,
      "viewer" => 20
    }

    @action_requirements %{
      "delete_user" => "super_admin",
      "modify_permissions" => "admin",
      "suspend_account" => "manager",
      "view_logs" => "operator",
      "read_data" => "viewer"
    }

    def check_permission(actor_role, action) do
      required_role = Map.get(@action_requirements, action, "super_admin")
      actor_level = Map.get(@role_hierarchy, actor_role, 0)
      required_level = Map.get(@role_hierarchy, required_role, 100)
      actor_level >= required_level
    end

    def get_effective_role(claims) do
      declared_role = Map.get(claims, "role", "viewer")
      delegation_chain = Map.get(claims, "delegation_chain", [])
      resolve_delegation(declared_role, delegation_chain)
    end

    defp resolve_delegation(base_role, []), do: base_role
    defp resolve_delegation(base_role, chain) when is_list(chain) do
      # Walk the delegation chain - each delegator must have
      # at least the privilege level being delegated
      final_role = List.last(chain) |> Map.get("delegated_role", base_role)
      if valid_chain?(chain, base_role) do
        final_role
      else
        base_role
      end
    end

    defp valid_chain?(chain, _base_role) do
      chain
      |> Enum.chunk_every(2, 1, :discard)
      |> Enum.all?(fn [delegator, _delegatee] ->
        delegator_role = Map.get(delegator, "role", "viewer")
        delegated_role = Map.get(delegator, "delegated_role", "viewer")
        check_permission(delegator_role, role_to_action(delegated_role))
      end)
    end

    defp role_to_action("super_admin"), do: "delete_user"
    defp role_to_action("admin"), do: "modify_permissions"
    defp role_to_action("manager"), do: "suspend_account"
    defp role_to_action("operator"), do: "view_logs"
    defp role_to_action(_), do: "read_data"
  end

  # GenServer implementation
  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_opts) do
    :ets.new(:audit_log, [:named_table, :ordered_set, :public])
    {:ok, %{processed: 0, queue: :queue.new()}}
  end

  def enqueue_message(message) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:enqueue, message})
  end

  def handle_cast({:enqueue, message}, state) do
    new_queue = :queue.in(message, state.queue)
    new_state = %{state | queue: new_queue}
    {:noreply, process_next(new_state)}
  end

  defp process_next(state) do
    case :queue.out(state.queue) do
      {{:value, message}, remaining_queue} ->
        handle_message(message)
        %{state | queue: remaining_queue, processed: state.processed + 1}
      {:empty, _} ->
        state
    end
  end

  defp handle_message(%{"type" => "action", "claims" => claims, "action" => action, "target" => target}) do
    effective_role = Authorization.get_effective_role(claims)
    actor_id = Map.get(claims, "sub", "unknown")

    authorized = Authorization.check_permission(effective_role, action)

    audit_entry = %AuditLog{
      timestamp: DateTime.utc_now(),
      actor_id: actor_id,
      action: action,
      resource: target,
      result: if(authorized, do: "permitted", else: "denied"),
      metadata: %{effective_role: effective_role, original_claims: claims}
    }

    AuditLog.record(audit_entry)

    if authorized do
      execute_action(action, target, actor_id)
    else
      Logger.warn("Unauthorized attempt: #{actor_id} tried #{action} on #{target}")
      {:error, :unauthorized}
    end
  end

  defp handle_message(%{"type" => "batch", "operations" => operations, "claims" => claims}) do
    # Process batch operations - inherit claims context
    Enum.each(operations, fn op ->
      merged = Map.merge(op, %{"type" => "action", "claims" => claims})
      handle_message(merged)
    end)
  end

  defp handle_message(%{"type" => "delegated_batch", "operations" => operations, "delegation_context" => ctx}) do
    # Delegated batch: each operation carries its own authorization context
    # The delegation_context provides the chain of trust
    Enum.each(operations, fn op ->
      op_claims = Map.get(op, "claims", %{})
      enriched_claims = Map.put(op_claims, "delegation_chain", Map.get(ctx, "chain", []))
      merged = Map.merge(op, %{"type" => "action", "claims" => enriched_claims})
      handle_message(merged)
    end)
  end

  defp execute_action("delete_user", target, actor) do
    Logger.info("EXECUTING: delete_user on #{target} by #{actor}")
    {:ok, :deleted}
  end

  defp execute_action("modify_permissions", target, actor) do
    Logger.info("EXECUTING: modify_permissions on #{target} by #{actor}")
    {:ok, :modified}
  end

  defp execute_action("suspend_account", target, actor) do
    Logger.info("EXECUTING: suspend_account on #{target} by #{actor}")
    {:ok, :suspended}
  end

  defp execute_action(action, target, actor) do
    Logger.info("EXECUTING: #{action} on #{target} by #{actor}")
    {:ok, :executed}
  end
end
